get.description: Query the status and results of a single video generation, H3-Context-IR, or video regeneration task within the last 7 days by task_id.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The task ID to query (the task_id returned when creating a task).

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

task.description: The task object returned by the H3 shared task query and list API.

model.description: The model name used for the task, e.g. MiniMax-H3.

status.description:
Task status:

- queued: Queued
- running: Running
- succeeded: Succeeded
- failed: Failed
- cancelled: Cancelled

error.description: Error information. Not returned when the task succeeds; returns code and message when the task fails.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of task creation time.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of task status update time.

content.description: Task output content, returned after the task succeeds.

url.description: Time-limited download URL for the video task output. Download or transfer promptly; can be re-queried after expiration.

prompt.description: Structured enhanced prompt generated by the H3-Context-IR task. Only returned when task_type=h3_context_ir and the task succeeds.

duration.description: Duration of the task output in seconds.

usage.description: Billing usage for this request. Video tasks return per-second metering fields; H3-Context-IR tasks return token usage fields.

total_seconds.description: Total billed seconds = input seconds + output seconds.

input_seconds.description: Billed seconds for input reference video (counted when reference video is included).

input_image_count.description: Number of images involved in this billing (first_frame + middle_frame + last_frame + reference_image all added together).

ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the task output; may return an empty string when not applicable to the current task type.

task_type.description:
Task type:

generation: Video generation
h3_context_ir: H3-Context-IR (/v2/h3_context_ir)
regeneration: Video regeneration (/v2/video_regeneration)

modality.description: Output modality. Video generation and video regeneration tasks return video; H3-Context-IR tasks return text.
